item.title: China Tests Quantum Technology in Power Grid
item.summary: Insider Brief China is testing quantum sensors, secure communications and computing in a working power substation, examining how the emerging technology could be applied to the country’s electrical grid. The 220-kilovolt Houdian Quantum Application Demonstration Substation in Hefei, in eastern China’s Anhui province, has deployed 85 domestically developed quantum devices across 18 categories, according to […]
